sa: सोऽवबद्धशिरस्त्राणः शुभकाञ्चनवर्मभृत्। रराज राजन् पुत्रस्ते काञ्चनः शैलराडिव॥
en: Clad in bright armour of gold, he put on that head-gear. Indeed, O king, your son then looked resplendent like a golden summit.

sa: केचित् पुत्रानुपादाय हतभूयिष्ठबान्धवः॥ विचुक्रुशुः पितुंस्त्वन्ये सहायानपरे पुनः।
en: Some tried to rescue their sons, having lost all their kinsmen and animals. Some loudly called their father, some their comrades and followers.

sa: प्रभिन्नकुम्भास्तु बहून् द्रवमाणानितस्ततः। पतमानांश्च सम्प्रेक्ष्य वित्रेसुस्तव सैनिकाः॥
en: Beholding those numberless elephants, with their frontal globes cut open, running hither and thither or falling down your soidiers were possessed by fear.

sa: ततोऽस्याकथयद् राजन् नारदः सर्वधर्मवित्॥ सर्वमेतद् यथावृत्तमतीव कुरुसंक्षयम्।
en: Conversant with duty and practices, Narada, then, O king, told him everything, as it had occurred, about the dreadful destruction of the Kurus.

sa: उद्यानानि महार्हाणि शयनान्यासनानि च। प्रतिभोगसुखेनैव कोशमस्य विरेचय॥
en: Making them attached to pleasure gardens and rich beds and seats, do you, by offering such objects of enjoyment, exhaust your eneiny's treasury.

sa: कुञ्जरैश्र स्यन्दनाः क्षुण्णा: सादिनश्च महारथैः। पदातिसंघाश्चाश्चौघैः पलायद्भिर्भयार्दितैः॥
en: In their fearful fight cars were shattered by elephants, the cavalry were crushed by carwarriors and the infantry were trampled down by horses.

sa: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं कौन्तेयाभक्ष्यभक्षणम्। प्रायश्चित्तविधानेन सर्वमेतेन शुद्ध्यति॥
en: All that I have told you, O son of Kunti, about the eating of forbidden food, inay be purified by such expiatory rites.

sa: अधर्मदर्शी यो राजा बलादेव प्रवर्तते। क्षिप्रमेवापयातोऽस्मादुभौ प्रथममध्यमौ॥
en: That king who neglects Righteousness and wishes to act with brute force, soon falls away from Righteousness and loses both Virtue and Profit.

sa: पुत्रं त्यजेममहितं कुलस्य हितं परं न च तत् त्वं चकर्थ। मेवं कर्ता परितप्तासि पश्चात्॥
en: I told you formerly as soon as the son was born, “Abandon this inauspicious child of yours. The good of your race is in it (abandoning).” But you did not accept my advice, if you did as I advised to do, you would not have repented.

sa: नाकुलिस्तु शतानीको वृषसेनं समभ्ययात्। विव्याध चैनं दशभिनौराचैर्मर्मभेदिभिः॥
en: The son of Nakula by name Shatanika charged Vrishasena and pierced the latter with ten Narachas that could penetrate into the very vitals.

sa: परिघोपमबाहुस्तु परिघं भास्करप्रभम्। बली बलवतस्तस्य पातयामास वक्षसि॥
en: Thereat the powerful (Nikumbha) having long-arm* threw his parigha resembling the Sun at the breast of that powerful one. *Lit. arms resembling parighas.

sa: अथोत्क्रुष्टं महचासीत् पाण्डवैर्जितकाशिभिः॥ धार्तराष्ट्रास्ततः सर्वे प्रायशो विमुखाभवन्।
en: The Pandavas then, anger for victory, sent up loud war-cries. As regards the Dhartarashtras, almost all of them fled away from the field.

sa: ततः शरैर्दीप्तमुखैर्यन्त्रितैरनुमन्त्रितैः। प्रत्यविध्यमहं तं तु वजैरिव शिलोच्चयम्॥
en: Then I pierced him with steady arrows of blazing points and inspired with mantras (just) as a mountain is pierced by a thunderbolt.

sa: तथा पद्मप्रतीकाशे स्वभावायतविस्तृते। क्रोधाभिताम्राक्षे रक्ते नेत्रे बभूवतुः॥
en: Under the influence of anger, his lotus-like eyes, naturally large and expanding, became still more extended, and also as red as the copper.

sa: सचिवोऽयं कपीन्द्रस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। तमेव काश्माणस्य ममान्तिकमिहागतः॥
en: He is the counsellor of the high-souled Sugriva, the lord of monkeys and has approached me, soliciting my friendship in his (Sugriva's) favour.

sa: यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः। निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्॥
en: Tama Happiness is that which deludes the self in the beginning and in its consequences, and which arises from sleep, condolence and foolishness.

sa: स भास्करसहस्रस्य संघातमिव भास्वरम्। रथमारुह्य शक्रारिरभिदुद्राव वानरान्॥
en: Ascending a car effulgent like a thousand suns mingling their rays into a burst of brilliance, that enemy of Sakra, charged the monkeys.

sa: आजग्मुः पाण्डुपुत्रस्य राजसूयं महाक्रतुम्। ददुस्तेषामावसथान् धर्मराजस्य शासनात्॥
en: Came to that great Rajasuya sacrifice of the son of Pandu. At the command of Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira), houses assigned to them all. were

sa: अयं समभ्येति तवान्तिकं बली निघ्नन् कुरूंचित्र इव ग्रहोऽर्जुनः। समृद्धकामोऽसि हतास्तवाहिता बलं तवायुश्च चिराय वर्धताम्॥
en: Shedding his effulgence like the constellation of Chirta, the all-powered Arjuna, after having massacred the Kuru forces, is speeding towards you. All your wishes have been gratified-your enemies, thrown overboard. May your prowess and the span of your life continue to increase for ever and ever.

sa: अहिंसां सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम्। दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम्॥
en: Non-doing of injury, truth, freedom from anger, renunciation, tranquility, freedom from fault-finding, compassion for all, absence of covetousness, gentleness, modesty, absence of restlessness.

sa: तव दिव्यं रथं यान्तमनुयान्ति वरार्थिनः। सिद्धचारणगन्धर्वा यक्षगुह्यकपन्नगाः॥
en: The Siddhas, the Charanas, the Gandharvas, the Yakshas, the Guhyakas and the Nagas, being desirous of obtaining boons, follow your moving celestials car.

sa: यथा समीपे ज्वलतोऽनलस्य संतापजं रूपमुपैति कश्चित्। न चान्तरं रूपगुणं बिभर्ति तथैव तद् दृश्यति रूपमस्य॥
en: As anything, placed in a burning fire before a spectator, assumes a certain colour on account of the light and heat that acts upon it, without taking any other colour or attribute, even so the Soul's form is seen to take its colour from the body.

sa: प्रसुप्तमिव चान्यत्र क्रीडन्तमिव चान्यतः। क्वचित् पर्वतमात्रैश्च जलराशिभिरावृतम्॥ संकुलं दानवेन्द्रैश्च पातालतलवासिभिः। रोमहर्षकरं दृष्ट्वा विषेदुः कपिकुञ्जराः॥
en: Seeing the sea, here as if asleep, there, as if playful, and at another place with surges measuring mountains; and thronged with the foremost Dānavas inhabiting the nether regions; and capable of causing one's hair to stand on end, those powerful monkeys were seized with sadness.

sa: सम्पातेर्वचनं श्रुत्वा हरयो रावणक्षयम्। हृष्टाः सागरमाजग्मुः सीतादर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः॥
en: Hearing from Sampāti that Rāvana was to be slain, the monkeys growing glad, came to the ocean, with the desire of seeing Sītā.

sa: अज्ञानतः कर्मयोनि भजन्ते तां तां राजंस्ते तथा यान्त्यभावम्। तथा वर्णा ज्ञानहीनाः पतन्ते घोरादज्ञानात्प्राकृतं योनिजालम्॥
en: Actuated by Ignorance, all men meet with death and go, O king, by birth which is the cause of acts. Shorn of Knowledge, all orders of men, dragged by terrible Ignorance, fall into varied orders of being on account of the principles that originate from Nature.

sa: तं प्रयान्तं मुनिगणा आशीर्वादैः समन्ततः। अपूजयन्महेन्द्राभं सहस्राक्षमिवामराः॥
en: Like to the immortals welcoming the Chief of the deities the Rșis showered blessings upon Rāma from all sides while he was proceeding.

sa: सरय्वाश्चोत्तरे तीरे यज्ञभूमिर्विधीयताम्। शान्तयश्चाभिवर्धन्तां यथाकल्पं यथाविधि ॥
en: And prepare the sacrificial ground on the north bank of the Sarayu. And perform the ceremonies capable of securing the rites from disturbance.

sa: रामोऽयमिति विज्ञाय जहास विकृतस्वनम्। अभ्यधावत संक्रुद्धो हरीन्विद्रावयरणे॥
en: Kowing that this was Rāma, (Kumbhakarņa) laughed in frightful accents; and then, wrought up with wrath, rushed against the monkeys in the encounter.

sa: बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि पञ्चाहुः पञ्चकर्मेन्द्रियाणि च। श्रोत्रादीन्यपि पञ्चाहुद्धियुक्तानि तत्त्वतः॥
en: Five amongst these are called organs of knowledge, and five, organs of action. The five beginning with the ear are connected with knowledge.

sa: हव्यं कव्यं च यत् किंचित् सर्वं तच्छ्रोत्रियोऽर्हति। दत्तं हि श्रोत्रिये साधौ ज्वलितेऽग्नौ यथा हुतम्॥
en: Havya (libation of ghee) and Kavya (edible offerings) should all be presented to a Brahmana who is learned in the Vedas. As an offering of ghee to Agnis is never in vain, so a gift to the Brahmanas learned in the Vedas is never in vain.

sa: सौमित्रे शोभते पम्पा वैदूर्यविमलोदका। फुल्लपद्मोत्पलवती शोभिता विविधैर्दुमैः॥
en: Behold, O Saumitri, how beautifully appear Pampā of transparent water like to Vaidurya, graced with full-blown red and white lotuses and various trees.

sa: न हि पापानि कर्माणि शुद्ध्यन्त्यनशनादिभिः। सीदत्यनशनादेव मांसशोणितलेपनः॥
en: Fasts and other penances, however they may weaken and dry up the body which is made of flesh and blood, cannot destroy sins.

sa: पुष्पसंछन्नशिखरा मारुतोत्क्षेपचञ्चलाः। अमी मधुकरोत्तंसाः प्रगीता इव पादपाः॥
en: Trees with flowery tops, tossed by the airy currents and crested with the bees, are as if dancing in accompaniment with melodious strains.

sa: ततः स पुरुषव्याघ्रः शार्दूलशिथिलश्चरन्। प्रविवेश महारङ्गं विराटमभिपूजयन्॥
en: Then that the best of men, having worshipped the king Virata, entered the spacious arena with listless steps like those of a lion.

sa: समे निविष्टा सा सेना प्रभूतसलिलाशये। चतुरङ्गबलोपेता शाल्वराजाभिपालिता॥
en: The army, headed by king Shalva, consisting of four kinds of troops, occupied a level ground where there was plentiful supply of water.

sa: रसानां प्रतिसंहारे सौभाग्यमनुगच्छति। आमिषप्रतिसंहारे पशून् पुत्रांश्च विन्दति॥
en: The man who casts off the enjoyment of all delicacies, acquires prosperity, and he who abstains from animal food, obtains children and cattle.

sa: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गौ गदाहस्तौ मनस्विनौ। ददृशाते महात्मानौ पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ॥
en: All their limbs covered with blood, the two great and energetic warriors both armed with maces, looked like two Kinshukas decked with flowers.

sa: ब्रह्मलोकगताश्चैव कथयन्ति महर्षयः। पतिश्च तपतां शश्वदादित्यस्तव भाषिता॥
en: The great Rishi living in the region of lords and who is said to be eternal lord of all luminaries, is your preceptor.

sa: सहेमचन्द्रतारार्काः पताकाः किङ्किणीयुताः॥ पश्य कर्णार्जुनस्यैताः सौदामन्य इवाम्बुदे।
en: See, O Karna, also the banners of Arjuna, adorned with rows of bells and golden moons and stars, like lightning on the clouds.

sa: कश्च प्रत्यक्षमुत्सृज्य संशयस्थमलक्षणम्। आयतिस्थं चरेद् धर्मं क्षत्रबन्धुरनिश्चितम्॥
en: What base Ksatriya setting aside this indubitable morality, resorts to a dubious and inauspicious course, which should be followed by the old alone?

sa: शृणु दानरहस्यानि श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितानि च। छायायां करिणः श्राद्धं तत् कर्णपरिवीजिते। दश कल्पायुतानीह न क्षीयेत युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Hear about the mysteries of charity as they have been expounded in the Shrutis and Smritis. O Yudhishthira, he who performs a Shraddha in the conjunction of Gajachhaya at a place fanned by the leaves of an Ashvattha tree enjoys its fruits one hundred thousand Kalpas.

sa: तदागच्छ महातेज आश्रमं पुण्यकर्मणः। तारयैनां महाभागामहल्यां देवरूपिणीम्॥
en: Therefore, O highly powerful one, do you enter into the hermitage of that pious one, and deliver the dignified and divinely fair Ahalyā.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरं प्रेप्सुराचार्यः शत्रुपूगहा। व्यधमत् तान्यनीकानि तूलराशिमिवानलः॥
en: Thereupon, the preceptor, the crusher of large bodies of foes, desirous of capturing Yudhishthira, consumed those troops like fire consuming heaps of cotton.

sa: अद्य ते मामका बाणास्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणाः। पास्यन्ति रुधिरं गात्राबाणशल्यान्तरोत्थितम्॥
en: To-day shall my shafts decked in gold, drink your blood flowing from your person and issuing of wounds inflicted by my resembling darts.

sa: अन्योन्यस्यावलुम्पन्ति सारमेया यथाऽमिषम्॥ राजानो भरतश्रेष्ठ भोक्तुकामा वसुंधराम्।
en: O foremost of the Bharata race, with the desire of enjoying earth they have become like dogs that snatch meat from one another.

sa: तस्यापि स्थनिर्घोषो महामेघरवोपमः। तस्यापि सुमहचापं दृढज्यं कनकोजवलम्॥
en: The clatter of his car also resembled the rumble of mighty clouds. His bow was also tough and strong with a hard string,

sa: एवमाचार्यपुत्रेण समाहूतो युयुत्सया॥ बहु मेनेऽर्जुनीऽऽत्मानमिति चाह जनार्दनम्
en: Having been thus invited by the son of the Preceptor out of desire for battle, Arjuna considered himself to be highly respected and

sa: क्रुद्धः सौमित्रिरुत्पत्य तूणादाक्षिप्य सायकम्। पुरस्तादतिकायस्य विचकर्ष महद्धनुः॥
en: And flying to fury, Sumitra's son, darting up, took out arrows from his quiver, and stretched his mighty bow in front of Atikāya.

sa: मुमुचुः श्वासमत्युष्णं दुःखशोकसमन्विताः। सप्तर्षयो जातभयास्तथा देवर्षयोऽपि च॥
en: The seven (celestial) Rishis, as also the other Rishis of Heaven, stricken with fear, and afflicted with grief and sorrow, breathed hot sights.

sa: तापयन्तौ शरैस्तीक्ष्णैरन्योन्यं तौ महारथौ। युगान्तप्रतिमौ वीरौ रेजतुर्भास्कराविव॥
en: Those two mighty car-warriors afflicting one another with their sharp-arrows, appeared beautiful like two suns that rise at the end of a Yuga.

sa: जटाबन्धनमन्यस्तु काष्टरज्जु मुदान्वितः। यज्ञभाण्डमृषिः कश्चित् काष्ठभारं तथापरः॥ औदुम्बरी बृसीमन्यः स्वस्ति केचित् तदावदन्। आयुष्यमपरे प्राहुर्मुदा तत्र महर्षयः॥ ददुश्चैवं वरान् सर्वे मुनयः सत्यवादिनः।
en: And some, a thread for tying up their matted locks; and some gladly gave a twine for binding faggots with, and some ascetic presented them with a sacrificial pot; and some, a quantity of fire-wood; and some, a seat made of udumbara (The glamorous fig tree). And some exclaimed, 'Svasti'; and some joyfully cried, “May you be long-lived!" And all those ascetics of truthful speech conferred on them blessings.

sa: अरक्षितारो लुब्धाच मानाहङ्कारदर्पिताः। केवलं दण्डरुचयो भविष्यन्ति युगक्षये॥
en: Full of avarice, swelling with pride and vanity, unable and unwilling to protect (their subjects) they will take pleasure in punishing (their subjects).

sa: एतस्मिन् वर्तमानस्य विधावप्रतिषेधिते। ब्राह्मणस्य महाराज नोच्छित्तिर्विद्यते क्वचित्॥
en: A Brahmana who follows all the ordinances in which there are no obstacles, does not fall off from this or the other world.

sa: उत्सेकेनाभिपन्नस्य गर्हितस्याहितस्य च। कर्मणः प्राप्नुहीदानीं तस्याद्य सुमहत्फलम्॥
en: Today receive the mighty fruit of that infamous act done through pride, productive of evil.* *Remarks Rāmānuja, 'here and in the next world.'

sa: निम्ने कृषि करिष्यन्ति योक्ष्यन्तिधुरिधेनुकाः। एकहायनवत्सांश्च योजयिष्यन्ति मानवाः॥
en: Men will till low-lands and employ cows and calves that are but one year old in drawing the plough and carrying the burdens.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा भीमसेनस्य मातृस्नेहात् प्रजल्पितम्। कारुण्येन मनस्तप्तं गमनायोपचक्रमे॥
en: Having heard this, Bhimasena's heart was warmed with compassion from the affection (he bore) for his mother and he began to proceed again.

sa: तादृशस्येदृशे काले कादृशेनाभिनोदितः। रणे वृष्णिप्रवीराणां द्वावेवातिरथौ स्मृतौ॥
en: For men like Arjuna, being urged on by men like myself. Of all the Vrishni heroes, two are reckoned as Atirathas in battle.

sa: वैरबद्धा भविष्यन्ति परस्परवधैषिणः। ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः संकीर्यन्तः परस्परम्॥ शूद्रतुल्या भविष्यन्ति तप:सत्यविवर्जिताः। अन्त्या मध्या भविष्यन्ति मध्याशान्त्या न संशयः।।
en: Will display enmity towards one another and will desire to take one another's life. Thus virtue diminished and their asceticism and truth gone Vaishyas. Brahmanas and Kshatriyas will all be equal to the Shudras. The lowest (orders of men) will rise to the middle (orders of men) and the middle will certainly descend to the lowest.

sa: ते वयं रावणं श्रुत्वा हतं सबलवाहनम्। त्रातारं विद्महे तात नान्यं भुवि नराधिपम्। तत्परित्रातुमिच्छामो लवणाद्भयपीडितान्॥
en: Hearing, O child, that Ravana together with all his forces and vehicles has been destroyed (by you), we know that there breathes not another king on earth capable of delivering us. Therefore our prayer is that you may deliver us afflicted with the fear of Lavana.

sa: भीमसेनदवाग्नेस्तु मम पुत्रांस्तृणोपमान्। प्रधक्षतो रणमुखे केऽतिष्ठन्नग्रतो नराः॥
en: Or What persons, stood before the Bhimaconflagration when it was engaged in consuming the heaps of straw and grass constituted by my sons?

sa: व्याघ्रदत्तस्तुपाञ्चाल्योद्रोणं विव्याघ मार्गणैः। पञ्चाशता शितै राजंस्तत उच्चुक्रुशुर्जनाः॥
en: Vyaghradatta, the prince of the Panchalas, pierced Drona with fifty whetted arrows; as thereupon, O monarch, the Pandava host uttered a loud shout.

sa: अध्यर्धमासमुषिता पथि सेना निरामया। हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णा केकयं समुपागमत्॥
en: The army, consisting of delighted and healthy subjects spending half a month in the way, arrived at the Kekaya kingdom in good health.

sa: शक्यश्चाप्यन्यथा कर्तुमाहारोऽप्यधिकस्त्वया। गोवृषो वा वराहो वा मृगो वा महिषोऽपि वा। त्वदर्थमद्य क्रियतां यच्चान्यदिह काक्षसि॥
en: You can appease you hunger with some other food which would be more plentiful. I am perfectly willing to procure for you any sort of food that would be palatable to you, whether it be an ox or a boar or a deer or a buffalo.

sa: इति पादातयोधाश्च हस्त्यश्वारोहबन्धकाः। अनाथास्तं विधिं लब्ध्वा वाचमेतामुदीरयन्॥
en: Thus did footmen and the riders and keepers of elephants and horses, as well as others, having experienced such a state, utter words.

sa: अक्रुद्ध्यत रणे भीमस्तैर्मधे प्रत्यवस्थितैः॥ सोऽवतीर्य रथात्तूर्णं गदापाणिरयुध्यता
en: Surrounded by them in battle, Bhima became angry with them. Quickly getting down from his car, he began to fight, with his mace.

sa: ततस्तानब्रवीद् राजन्नर्जुनः प्रहसन्निवा पार्थिवत्वं चिकीर्षामि धर्मराजस्य धीमतः॥
en: Having been thus addressed, Arjuna smilingly thus spoke to them, “I desire the acquisition of the imperial dignity for the intelligent Dharamaraja Yudhishthira.

sa: पितामहं शान्तनवं च वृद्धं द्रोणं गुरुं च प्रणिपत्य मू । ज्छरैर्विचित्रैरभिवाद्य चैव॥ दुर्योधनस्योत्तमरत्नचित्रं चिच्छेद पार्थो मुकुटं शरेण।
en: He then saluted with his head bowed on the feet of grand-father Bhishma and preceptor Drona and talked on certain matters for a while. He then saluted through application of arrows varied ways to Ashvatthama, Kripacharya and other respected Kauravas (Banahika, Somadatta etc.) and cut the excellent gem-studded crown off from Duryodhana's head through an arrow.

sa: तान् प्रहृष्टांस्तत: सूता राजभक्तिपुरस्कृताः॥ निर्दिष्टा नरदेवेन रथाञ्छीघ्रमयोजयन्।
en: Then those charioteers, delightedly having the devotion to the king always before them, speedily got the cars ready as commanded by the king.

sa: श्रुत्वा गाण्डीवनिर्घोषं विस्कूर्जितमिवाशनेः। त्रस्तानि सर्वसैन्यानि व्यपागच्छन् महाहवात्॥
en: Hearing the twang of Gandiva like the rumble of thunder and being possessed by fear, all the soldiers fled away from the battle-field.

sa: नीलश्च महता चाव्णा दूषणावरजं प्रमाथिनमभिद्रुत्य प्रममाथ महाबलः॥
en: (And) the monkey Nila, endued with a vast strength, rushing towards Pramathin, the younger brother of Dushana crushed him with a huge rock.

sa: निर्घाताः पृथिवीकम्पा कजबंहितनिःस्वनाः। आसंश्च सर्वयोधानां पातयन्तो मनांस्युत॥
en: There were also earthquakes and whirlwinds and roars made by elephants which succeeded in casting a shade on the minds of all warriors.

sa: वृन्दारकं कुरुमध्येष्वमूढ़ महाप्रज्ञं सर्वधर्मोपपन्नम्। न तस्य युद्धं रोचते वै कदाचिद् वैश्यापुत्रं कुशलं तात पृच्छेः॥
en: You should also enquire about the health of the son of Dhritarashtra by his Vaishya wife, who is the best among the Kurus and one among them, not a fool, of great wisdom and endued with all virtues. By no means is he inclined to fight.

sa: यावच्च मार्दवेनैतान् राजन्नुपचरिष्यसि। तावदेते हरिष्यन्ति तव राज्यमरिंदम॥
en: So long as you treat these, O king, with kindness, they will deprive you of your kingdom, O you chastiser of your foes.

sa: शङ्खशब्दा: समुरजा भेर्यश्च मधुसूदन। उत्कृष्टसिंहनादश्च सुब्रह्मण्यो भविष्यति॥
en: The sounds of conch shells, of labors and drums and the roars of lions will announce the hour of dinner in that sacrifice.

sa: कर्मणां तु प्रशस्तानामनुष्ठानं सुखावहम्। तेषामेवाननुष्ठानं पश्चात्तापकरं मतम्॥
en: The doing of acts that are commendable leads to happiness; the omission to do these acts causes injury afterwards, which is my opinion.

sa: वैयाघ्रकोशे निहितो हेमचित्रो दुरासदः। सुफलचित्रकोशश्च किङ्किणीसायको महान्॥
en: Whose is this huge sword of excellent blade, variegated with gold and tinkling bells and put in a variegated sheath of tiger skin?

sa: मणिस्वस्तिकचक्राङ्काः कमण्डलुकलक्षणाः। सहस्रसंख्यां बलिनः सर्वे रौद्रा: स्वभावतः॥
en: And having the mark of gem, Svastika, circles and Kamandulu-all of them, each with the strength of a thousand, are by nature fierce.

sa: अगदस्याप्यधनुषो विरथस्य विवर्मणः। बाहुभ्यां युद्ध्यमानस्य कस्तिष्ठेग्रतः पुमान्॥
en: Who can stay in front of that man fighting with his two arms without mace or bow and without being on his car.

sa: पुरद्वारेषु सर्वेषु गुल्म: स्थावरजङ्गमाः। बभूवुः पत्तिबहुलाः प्रभूतगजवाजिनः॥
en: And all the city gates were guarded by permanent and temporary encampments containing large numbers of infantry and by innumerable elephants and horses.

sa: तथा माहिष्मतीवासी नीलो नीलायुधैः सह॥ महीपालो महावीर्यैर्दक्षिणापथवासिभिः।
en: So did Nila, the resident of Mahishmati, a king of great strength along with the residents of the southern countries with blue weapons.

sa: तस्य तैः पुरुषव्याप्रैर्वनमालाधरैर्बलम्॥ अशोभत यथा मत्तैर्वनं प्रक्रीडितैर्गजैः।
en: His army, with those foremost among men, graced with garlands of wild flowers, looked charming as a forest run about by wild elephants.

sa: दशग्रीवस्तु सर्वेषां श्रेष्ठो राक्षसपुङ्गवः। महोत्साहो महावीर्यो महासत्त्वपराक्रमः॥
en: That foremost of Rakshasas, the ten-headed (Ravana) became the greatest of them all; highly energetic, powerful and gifted with great strength and prowess.

sa: धर्ममाचरतो राज्ञः सद्धिश्चरितमादितः। वसुधा वसुसम्पूर्णा वर्धते भूतिवर्धिनी॥
en: The earth full of wealth increases the worldly prosperity of the king who practices virtue followed by good men from the ancient time.

sa: परापवादनिरताः परदुःखोदयेषु च। परस्परविरोधे च यतन्ते सततोत्थिताः॥
en: Those that are ever engaged in speaking ill of others ever engage themselves in quarrels which give pain to others with great care.

sa: आवयोर्वचनात् सूत ज्येष्ठानप्यभिवादयन्। यवीयसश्च कुशलं पश्चात् पृष्ट्वैवमुत्तरम्॥
en: Before repeating our answer, O Suta, convey our respects to our elders in age and then asking about the health of our younger,

sa: सौमित्रिरपि नाराजैर्दृढधन्वा जितक्लमः। आदिश्यादिश्य दुर्गस्थान् पातयामास राक्षसान्॥
en: And that mighty bowman, the indefatiguable son of Sumitra also, naming (particular) Rakshasas who were stationed in the forts killed them with Narachas.

sa: सूपस्करेण शुभ्रेण वैयाघेण वरूथिना। शैब्यसुग्रीवयुक्तेन प्रत्यदृश्यत दारुकः॥
en: Which was also covered with white tiger skins, and to which were yoked his excellent horses, among which was Shaivya he saw Daruka.

sa: पतिभिः पञ्चभिः शूरैरग्निकल्पैः प्रहारिभिः। उपपन्ना महेष्वासैद्रौपदी दुःखभागिनी॥
en: Draupadi has a bad lot, though she has five husbands, all heroes like the fire, all smiters of foes and all great bowmen.

sa: हेमचित्रसमुत्सेधां सर्वशैक्यायसीं गदाम्। प्रगृह्याभ्यद्रवद् भीम: सैन्धवं कालचोदितम्॥
en: Then armed with a mace made entirely of Shaikya iron and coated with gold, Bhimasena rushed towards the Saindhava king doomed to death.

sa: भवेदिति महाबुद्धिर्बहुधा तदचिन्तयत्। तस्यासीन्न विषेणेदमुदकं दूषितं यथा॥
en: Thus that highly intellectual one gave way to many thoughts. But he could, in no way, persuade himself that the water was prisoned,

sa: तस्यास्तदाक्षिप्य वचो हितमुक्तं कपीश्वरः। पर्यशङ्कत तामीर्षुः सुग्रीवगतमानसाम्॥
en: (But) the lord of the monkeys, discarding her beneficial words, was filled with jealousy and suspected that her heart was inclined towards Sugriva.

sa: सा सभाद्वारमासाद्य रुदती मत्स्यमब्रवीत्। अवेक्षमाणा सुश्रोणी पतीस्तान् दीनचेतसः॥ आकारमभिरक्षन्ती प्रतिज्ञाधर्मसंहिता। दह्यमानेव रौद्रेण चक्षुषा दुपदात्मजा॥
en: The weeping daughter of Draupadi, endowed with excellent hips, approaching the entrance of the court and beholding her lords of melancholy mood, tenacious in keeping up the disguise observing the pledge they had already sworn, burning with flashing eyes, spoke to the king of the Matsya's.

sa: ततश्च पुनरुत्थाय सुखी विश्रान्तवाहनः। प्रययौ पृथिवीपालैर्वृतः शतसहस्रशः॥
en: Then his army, which was weary and tried, having rested, again set out surrounded by hundred and thousands of rulers of the earth.

sa: अष्टानिमायसी घोरां गदां काञ्चनभूषणाम्। मनसाऽहं प्रपश्यामि ब्रह्मदण्डमिवोद्यतम्॥
en: That terrible steel mace with eight sides and ornamented with gold I now see in my mind like the staff of Brahma uplifted.

sa: अन्यत् कुम्भादपां पूर्णादन्यत् पादावसेचनात्। अन्यत् कुशलम्प्रश्नान्नैवेक्ष्यति जनार्दनः॥
en: On anything else besides a pot full water and water for washing his feet and interrogations on his health even cast his eyes.

sa: अनेकशतविस्तीर्णं योजनानां महोदधिम्। निमिनक्रझपा ।सं चिन्तयन्तः सुदुःखिताः॥
en: Considering that this mighty ocean was many hundred yojanas in width and the abode of whales, alligators and fishes, we became sorely grieved.

sa: तौ गजाविव चासाद्य विषाणाप्रैः परस्परम्। शरैः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैरन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः॥
en: They wounded each other with arrows shot from bows drawn to the highest stretch like two elephants assailing each other with their tusks.

sa: फलमूलाशनास्ते हि सुखाहाँ दुःखमुत्तमम्। प्राप्तकालमनुध्यान्तः सेहिरे वरपूरुषाः॥
en: Although deserving of happiness, those best of men, brooding over their miserable plight, passed their days in misery living on fruits and roots.

sa: तपस्विनो महात्मानो वेदप्रत्ययदर्शिनः। उदीर्यमाणं राजानं क्रोधदीप्ता द्विजातयः॥
en: Those twice born devotees, of large souls and acquainted with the cases cited in the Vedas, excited by wrath, said to that king.

sa: उपवासैश्च विविधैर्दीक्षाभिर्नियमैस्तथा। आत्मनो लघुतां कृत्वा बभूव मृगचारिणी॥
en: By observing fasts and different sorts of religions rites, as also ceremonies. She reduced her body and adopted the life of a deer.

sa: तं प्रविष्टमभिप्रेक्ष्य पुत्रमुत्पथमास्थितम्। विगर्हमाणा गान्धारी शमार्थं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing her son who was following the wrong course enter, Gandhari with a view to peace, spoke these words finding fault with him.

sa: गृहीतमाल्यदामां तां रथमारोप्य माधवीम्। पूर्यदुश्च भगिनीमाश्रमे पर्यधावताम्॥
en: Making, Madhvi seated on a chariot with garlands and flowers on her person; Puru and Yadu too followed their sister to the hermitage.

sa: अनुज्ञातास्तु गन्धर्वाः पाण्डुपुत्रेण धीमता। सहाप्सरोभिः संहृष्टाश्चित्रसेनमुखा ययुः॥
en: Thus requested by the greatly intelligent Pandava, the Gandharvas became greatly delighted. They went away with the Apsaras with Chitrasena at their head.

sa: हस्त्यश्वरथपादातं यथास्थानं न्यवेशयत्। अथोपविष्टं राजानं पर्यङ्के ज्वलनप्रभे॥
en: With his elephants, cars, cavalry and infantry stationed all around (the camp), he was seated on an elevated bed-stead as bright as fire.

sa: गङ्गायाः सूतविषयं चप्पामनुययौ पुरीम्। स मञ्जूषागतो गर्भस्तरङ्गरुह्यमानकः॥
en: And that basket containing the child, borne along the waves of the Ganga arrived at the city of Champa in the Suta territory.

sa: पोथितं भीमसेनेन तमिन्द्रेणेव दानवम्। संस्कारयितुमिच्छन्तो बहिर्नेतुं प्रचक्रमुः॥
en: Then seeing him crushed by Bhimasena like a Danava by Indra they tried to take him out side for performing his obsequial ceremonies.

sa: जाम्बूनदमयैः पुढेश्चित्रचापविनिर्गतैः। प्राच्छादयदमेयात्मा दिशः सूर्यस्य च प्रभाम्॥
en: That of immeasurable energy enveloped all the quarters and the lustre of the sun with gold-winged arrows discharged from a variegated bow. one

sa: निदर्शनान्युपायांश्च बहून्युद्धर्षणानि च। अनुदर्शितरूपोऽसि पश्यामि कुरु पौरुषम्॥
en: I see, you have shown yourself fit to appreciate many examples, expedients and words given vent to excite your energy-now show your manliness.

sa: इति राजाब्रवीद् देवं नेति देवस्तमब्रवीत्। अजय्यांश्चाप्यवध्यांश्च वारयिष्यसि तान् युधि॥ ऋतेऽर्जुनं महाबाहुं नरं नाम सुरेश्वरम्। बदाँ तप्ततपसं नारायणसहायकम्॥
en: This the king said to the god but he said "this cannot be." You shall once check them in battle who are unconquerable and are not capable of being slain, except the mightyarmed Arjuna who is the lord of the celestials incarnate named Nara. He carried on devout penances in Badari and is backed by Narayana.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणो बीभत्सुर्वैराटिमपराजितः। समाश्वास्य मुहूर्तं तमुत्तरं भरतर्षभ॥
en: Thus speaking to Uttara, the son of Virata, Bibhatsu, never defeated in battle, excited him for the time being, O foremost of Viratas.

sa: कृत्वा बहून्यकार्याणि पाण्डवेषु नृशंसवत्। मिथ्यावृत्तिरनार्यः सन्नद्य विप्रतिपद्यसे॥
en: Having done many wicked deeds like a cruel man towards them and behaved like a dishonorable man, you now try to took different.

sa: जहि वीर दुरात्मानं मायापरमधार्मिकम्। रावणिं क्रूरकर्माणं सर्वलोकभयावहम्॥
en: Slay, O hero, this wicked one, this son of Ravana, given to illusion, and of terrific feats, the fear of all the worlds.

sa: अथर्भरजसो नाम बालिसुग्रीवयोः पिता। सर्ववानरराजासीवेजसा इव भास्करः॥
en: There was a king of all Mongoloids named as Rkşarajā; the father of Vāli and Sugrīva. He was as glorious as the Sun.

sa: उवाच च समीपस्थानराक्षसान्राक्षसेश्वरः। क्रोधाव्यक्तकथस्तत्र निर्दहत्रिव चक्षुषा ॥
en: There upon the lord of Rākşasas, in anger as if burning down everything with his look addressed the Rākşasas who were near him.

sa: मार्तण्डस्त्वब्रवीत्तत्र भगवांस्तिमिरापहः। तेजसोऽस्य मदीयस्य ददामि शतिका कलाम्॥
en: The god Mārtanda, the dispeller of darkness, on that occasion told that I will bestow upon him the hundredth part of my brilliance,

sa: ताभिराश्वासिता सीता रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्। उवाचात्महितं वाक्यं वृत्तशौटीर्यगर्वितम्॥
en: Thus consoled by them, and being proud of her good conduct and her husband's heroism, Sītā thus addressed Rāvana, the lord of Raksasas.

sa: द्रक्ष्यन्त्यरिं ममाङ्कस्थं संसदूरुकराम्बरम्। लम्बमानं दशग्रीवं गरुडस्येव पन्नगम्॥
en: Everyone will behold the enemy Rāvana, under my arm pit as a serpent possessed by Garuda, with his thighs, arms and clothes loosened.

sa: रामः कमलपत्राक्षः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननः । रूपदाक्षिण्यसम्पन्नः प्रसूतो जनकात्मजे॥
en: O daughter of Janaka, Rāma has eyes like lotus-petals and a countenance resembling the full-moon and is gifted with great beauty and goodness.

sa: अकामां कामयानस्य शरीरमुपतप्यते॥ इच्छती कामयानस्य प्रीतिर्भवति शोभना।
en: Again he who desire for an unwilling dame burn his own person—and he who desire for a willing damsel, attain excess of delight.

sa: स तद्विहाय शयनं पाण्डुराच्छादनास्तृतम्। उत्तस्थौ नागशयनाद्धरिनारायणो यथा॥
en: Like to Hari rising up from the bed of serpents Rāma, thus eulogised, rose up from his bed covered with a white coverlet.

sa: न तेऽस्त्यशक्यं समरेषु कर्मणां न तेऽस्त्यकार्यं मतिपूर्वमन्त्रणे। न सोऽस्ति कश्चित् त्रिषु संग्रहेषु न वेद यस्तेऽस्त्रबलं बलं च॥
en: There is no deed which you cannot perform in the field; and there is nothing in counsel capable of being arrived at by arguing on the lines prescribed by the scriptures, which you are not equal to; and there is none in all the three worlds who dose not know your strength and prowess in arms.

sa: कश्च लक्ष्मणमुक्तानां रामकोपानुवर्तिनाम्। शराणामग्रतः स्थातुं शक्तो देवासुरेष्वपि॥
en: Who is there even among celestials and Asuras that is competent to stay before the shafts shot by Lakşmaņa and Rāma in wrath?

sa: मनुजेन्द्रार्तरूपेण यदुक्तस्त्वं हनूमता। तदयुक्तमहं मन्ये सागरस्येव शोषणम्॥
en: O king, all that Hanumān in distressful guise had communicated to you I deem as improbable, like to the drying of the deep.

sa: एतत्कुक्षौ समुद्रस्य स्कन्धावारनिवेशनम्॥ अत्र पूर्व महादेवः प्रसादमकरोद्विभुः।
en: On the bank of this ocean I halted with my soldiers. And here Mahadeva, the lord of the celestials, was propitiated with me.

sa: ऋक्षराजस्तथेत्युक्त्वा स्वेनानीकेन संवृतः। आगच्छत्पश्चिमं द्वारं हनूमान्यत्र वानरः॥
en: Thereupon, saying, 'So be it,' that king of bears, surrounded by his forces, approached the Western gate, where the monkey, Hanumān, was stationed.

sa: स नियुक्तस्ततस्तेन सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः। नमस्यशिरसा देव्यै सीतायै प्रत्यभाषत।७।।
en: Thus directed by him, that one (Hanumān) with his down standing on end, bowing down the head to that revered one, Sītā, replied.

sa: तामापतन्ती दृष्ट्वैव रथं सारथिना तदा। विधेयाश्वसमायुक्तो विदूरमपवाहितः॥
en: Beholding that crag about to fall down on the car, the charioteer moved his horses and it was speedily brought at some distance.

sa: तेषामशीतिसाहस्रं शूलमुद्गरपाणिनाम्। मया तस्मिन् वनोद्देशे परिघेण निषूदितम्॥
en: I despatched with my inace in no time eighty thousand of them no sooner than they entered the forest with darts and maces.

sa: ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं पूर्वमिन्द्रार्थममितौजसा। दत्तं सुरपतेः पूर्व त्रिलोकजयकाक्षिणः॥
en: It was made by Brahmä of undecaying prowess for Indra and conferred by him upon the lord of celestials desirous of acquiring victory.

sa: तयोः पादाभिघाताच्च निमग्ना चाभवन्मही। व्याघूशिततरङ्गश्च चुक्षुभे वरुणालयः॥
en: And with the stamping of their feet, the earth was rent into rivers, and the main was waxed, with its billows surging furiously.

sa: दीर्घकेश्यः सुचार्वङ्गयः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाः। पीनस्तनतटा मध्ये वज्रवेदिसमप्रभाः॥ रथकूबरसंकाशैः श्रोणिदेशैर्मनोहराः। स्त्रियः सुराङ्गनाप्रख्या निष्टप्तकनकप्रभाः।८।। शोकदुःखभयवस्ता विह्वलाश्च सुमध्यमाः। तासां निश्वासवातेन सर्वतः संप्रदीपितम्॥ अग्निहोत्रमिवाभाति संनिरुद्धाग्निपुष्पकम्। दशग्रीववशं प्राप्तास्तास्तु शोकाकुलाः स्त्रियः॥
en: They had long hairs, graceful persons, countenances resembling the full-moon, rising breast, slender waist like that of a black-bee and were graceful with back like the pole of a car. They were like the females of the celestials and the burning gold and were all afflicted by grief, sorrow and terror and were young. And the car was ablaze on all sides with the sighing of those damsels and Pușpaka looked like the chamber where fire is kept perpetually.

sa: नेयमन्येन नगरी शक्या धर्षयितुं बलात्। रक्षिता रावणबलैरुद्यतायुधपाणिभिः॥
en: This city protected by the forces of Rãvaņa with their hands holding upraised arms, is incapable of being forcibly subdued by any other.

sa: यत्तु कार्यं मनुष्येण शौटीर्यमवलम्ब्यताम्। तदलंकरणायैव कर्तुर्भवति सत्वरम्॥
en: Do you do even what should be done by a man-summon your manliness; for what an actor does promptly, conduce to his success.

sa: ततः काञ्चनमत्युग्रमृषभं पर्वतोत्तमम्। कैलासशिखरं चात्र द्रक्ष्यस्यरिनिषूदन ॥
en: There you will see that best of mountiansthe golden Rşabha of terrific aspect, and, O smiter of foes, the peak also of Kailāśa.

sa: तेषां सेनापतिर्वीरो नीलो वानरपुंगवः। संयतश्चरतां श्रेष्ठस्तद्बलं पर्यवारयत्॥
en: That foremost of rangers possessed of excellence, and of restrained senses, the heroic Nīla, general (of the army), kept going round the ranks.

sa: अन्योन्यैराहताः सक्ताः सस्वनुर्भीमनिःस्वनाः। ऊर्मयः सिन्धुराजस्य महाभेर्य इवाम्बरे॥
en: The waves of the mighty deep beating at each other continually, set up a sound resembling that of a trumpet in the sky.

sa: ततो हयरथाकीर्णं पताकाध्वजशोभितम्। निर्ययौ राक्षसबलं नर्दमानं युयुत्सया॥
en: Then burning for battle, setting up roars went out the Rākşasas ranks, thronging with steeds and cars, and graced with pennons and standards.

sa: आश्वासितो लक्ष्मणेन रामः संध्यामुपासत। स्मरन्कमलपत्राक्षी सीतां शोकाकुलीकृतः॥
en: And consoled by Laksmana, Rama, stricken with thought touching Sītā having eyes like lotus-petals, engaged in rites relating to the worship of Eve.

sa: अथ शक्तिं समासाद्य कालरात्रिमिवान्तकः। चिक्षेपानिलपुत्राय त्रिशिरा रावणात्मजः॥
en: Then taking a dart even as the destroyer employ the fatal night, Ravana's son, TriSiras discharged it at the offspring of the wind-god.

sa: ततः पितामहस्तत्र त्रैलोक्यगतिरव्ययः। आजगाम द्रुतं देवो विमानवरमास्थितः॥
en: Then that way of the triune sphere, that God, the undeteriorating Great-father, swiftly presented himself on the scene mounted on his excellent car.

sa: एष तस्मात्प्रणश्यामि दर्शनादस्य रक्षसः। इत्युक्त्वा सरथः साश्वस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: Therefore shall I disappear from the sight of this Rākşasa.' Having said this, even there did he vanish with his car and horses.

sa: प्रगृह्य नियमान्धोराराक्षसा नृपसत्तम। विचेरुस्ते तपो घोरं सर्वभूतभयावहम्॥
en: And adopting rigid restrictions, the Rākṣasas, O best of kings, entered upon austerities, terrible, and capable of arousing the fear of all beings.

sa: विकीर्णा पर्वतास्तैश्च दुमच्छिन्नैश्च संयुगे। हतैश्च कपिरक्षोभिर्दुर्गमा वसुधाभवत्॥
en: In that encounter the earth became impassable, having been scattered with crags baffled and severed trees and (warriors) slain by monkeys and Rākṣasa.

sa: ततोऽहमहमित्येवं गर्जन्तो नैर्ऋतर्षभाः। रावणस्य सुता वीराः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमाः॥
en: Then those foremost of Naiſtas-the heroic sons of Rāvaņa-endowed with the prowess of Sakra himself-roared out, I will go,' 'I will go.' or

sa: एतत्कुक्षौ समुद्रस्य स्कन्धावारनिवेशनम्॥ अत्र पूर्व महादेवः प्रसादमकरोद्विभुः।
en: On the bank of this ocean I halted with my soldiers. And here Mahadeva, the lord of the celestials, was propitiated with me.

sa: नारदस्तु महातेजा देवर्षिरमितप्रभः। अब्रवीन्मेघपृष्ठस्थो रावणं पुष्पके स्थितम्॥ राक्षसाधिपते सौम्य तिष्ठ विश्रवसः सुत। प्रीतोऽस्म्यभिजनोपेत विक्रमैरूर्जितैस्तव॥
en: That Devarsi the exceedingly energetic Nārada of immeasurable splendour, seated on the back of the cloud, addressed Ravana, who was stationed in Puspaka, saying, O lord of Raks asas, o placid one, O son of Viśravā, stay. I am well pleased with your prowess and fame.

sa: ततो वित्रासयन्मान्पृथिव्यां राक्षसाधिपः। आससाद घने तस्मिन्नारदं मुनिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: As the lord of Rākşasas was ranging the earth frightening everyone, Nārada foremost of ascetics, came to that wood mounted on a cloud,

sa: पश्य मत्तविहङ्गानि प्रलीनभ्रमराणि च। कोकिलाकुलखण्डानि दोधवीति शिवोऽनिलः॥
en: Behold the intoxicated birds, and the black bees blending (with the blossoms). And the blessed breeze sway the trees vocal with the coels.

sa: न जानाति पुरा वीर्यं मम युद्धे स राघवः। मम चापमयीं वीणां शरकोणैः प्रवादिताम्।॥ ज्याशब्दतुमुलां घोरामार्तगीतमहास्वनाम्। नाराचतलसंनादां नदीमहितवाहिनीम्।। अवगाह्य महारङ्गं वादयिष्याम्यहं रणे॥
en: Rāghava has not in conflict formerly known my bow representing my Vinā sounded with my shafts; having tremendous sounds proceeding from the strings; dreadful; with the cries of distressed people for its mighty strains of music; and resonant with the reports of Nārāchas and palms. And, having bathed in the great field of battle of representing the river of bostile forces, I will in the encounter strike (this Vinā).

sa: सोऽम्बुजो हरिणाध्मातः सर्वप्राणेन शङ्खराट्। ररास भीमनिर्हादस्त्रैलोक्यं व्यथयन्निव॥
en: Winded by Hari with his utmost might, that water-sprung king of conchs, endowed with terrific blares, roared, as if afflicting the three worlds.

sa: रूपमुत्तिष्ठतस्तस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य तद्बभौ। युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि कालस्येव दिधक्षतः॥
en: Then as he sat up, Kumbhakarņa's form appeared like that of the Destroyer himself at the universal wreck, intent upon consuming all creatures.

sa: सा मुहुर्तात्समाश्वस्य परिलभ्याथ चेतनाम्। तच्छिरः समुपस्थाय विललापायतेक्षणा॥
en: Then, recovering after a while, and having regained her consciousness, the large-eyed one, placing the head in her front, gave way to grief.

sa: विजयस्वार्यपुत्रेति सोऽभिवाद्य प्रसाद्य च। न्यवेदयदनुप्राप्तं प्रहस्तं वाहिनीपतिम्॥
en: May the worshipful one be victorious! And saluting and propitiating him, (Ravana), he told him that Prahasta, general of the forces, had arrived.

sa: तैस्तु तत्र महामात्यैर्महोदरशुकादिभिः। अलापवशेषास्ते यक्षाः कृता वातैरिवाम्बुदाः।।१६
en: And as the wind scatter clouds, the small remnant of Yaksa army was scattered by the redoubtable councillors (of Ravana) Mahodara, Suka, etc.

sa: शैलैः शूलैश्च खङ्गैश्च विमुक्तैः कपिराक्षसैः। भविष्यत्यावृता भूमिमा॑सशोणितकर्दमा।२१।।
en: The Earth, converted into mud with flesh and gore, shall be covered with darts and javelins and swords, discharged by Rākşasas and monkeys.

sa: तस्मादनिर्वेदकरं यत्नं चेष्टेऽहमुत्तमम्। अदृष्टांश्च विचेष्यामि देशान् रावणपालितान्॥
en: Therefore will I put forth fresh dear efforts vigorously. I will search such places held by Rāvana as I have not yet seen.

sa: सोऽतिपत्य मुहूर्तेन श्रीमान्रावणमन्दिरम्। ददर्शासीनमव्यग्रं रावणं सचिवैः सह॥
en: Arriving near that subduer of enemies, Rāvana, in a moment, that graceful one saw Rāvana, sitting calmly in the midst of his ministers.

sa: लक्ष्मणश्चापि रामश्च शरैराशीविषोपमैः।।।। दृश्यादृश्यानि रक्षांसि प्रवराणि निजघ्नतुः।
en: Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa with shafts resembling venomous serpents, slaughtered the foremost among the Rakşasas-both those that were seen and those that were not.

sa: प्रेषितोऽहं तव भ्रात्रा दशग्रीवेण सुव्रत॥ त्वत्समीपं महाबाहो सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वर। वचनं मम वित्तेश यद्ब्रवीति दशाननः॥
en: O you of excellent vows, I have been sent to you by your brother, the Ten-necked one. O long-armed one, O foremost of those versed in all branches of learning, do you listen to my words, O lord of wealth, and what the Ten-faced one says.

sa: तं पर्वताग्रमाकाशे रक्षोबाणविदारितम्। विकीर्णं पतितं दृष्ट्वा हनूमान्क्रोधमूर्च्छितः॥
en: And finding that mountain top severed by the shafts of the Räksasa and scattered in pieces, Hanumān was seized with a mighty wrath.

sa: हरयश्चापि तं दृष्ट्वा संतापं परमं गताः। शोकाश्चिकुशुधैरमश्रुपूरितलोचनाः॥
en: The monkeys also seeing him, were plunged in sorrow; and they, their eyes flooded with tears, began to cry in grief of heart.

sa: रजश्चारुणवर्णाभं सुभीममभवद्भृशम्॥ उद्धृतं हरिरक्षोभिः संरुरोध दिशो दश।
en: And fearful was the dust red-hued that was raised incessantly by the monkeys and the Rākṣasa; and it enveloped the ten cardinal points.

sa: देशकालाभियुक्तं तु युक्तवाक्याभिधायि तत्। रताविरतसंसुप्तं ददर्श हरियूथपः॥
en: That leader of monkey bands saw (women) versed in season and place, and understanding the meanings of words consonant with season and place.

sa: एवमुक्तः सुरैर्ब्रह्माचिन्तयत्पद्मसंभवः॥ चिन्तिता चोपतस्थेऽस्य पार्श्व देवी सरस्वती।
en: Thus addressed by the celestials, Brahmā, the Lotus-sprung one, pondered. The goddess, Sarasvatī, who was by his side was also agitated by anxiety.

sa: अङ्गदाभिहतास्तत्र राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः॥ विभिन्नशिरस: पेतुर्निकृता इव पादपाः।
en: And attacked by Angada there, the Raksasas of dreadful vigour, with their heads riven, fell down like to trees that have been uprooted.

sa: निर्जित्य राक्षसेन्द्रस्तं धनदं हृष्टमानसः। पुष्पकं तस्य जग्राह विमानं जयलक्षणम्॥ काञ्चनस्तम्भसंवीतं वैदूर्यमणितोरणम्। मुक्काजालप्रतिच्छन्नं सर्वकालफलद्रुमम्॥ मनोजवं कामगमं कामरूपं विहङ्गमम्। मणिकाञ्चनसोपानं तप्तकाञ्चनवेदिकम्॥ देवोपवाह्यपक्षय्यं सदादृष्टिमनःसुखम्। बह्वाश्चर्य भक्तिचित्रं ब्रह्मणा परिनिर्मितम्॥ निर्मितं सर्वकामैस्तु मनोहरमनुत्तमम्। न तु शीतं न चोष्णं च सर्वर्तुसुखदं शुभम्॥ स तं राजा समारुह्य कामगं वीर्यनिर्जितम्। जितं त्रिभुवनं मेने दर्पोत्सेकात्सुदुर्मतिः। जित्वा वैश्रवणं देवं क
en: Conquering the bestower of wealth, the lord of Raksasas, with a delighted heart, possessed himself of his Puspaka, the car, as a sign of victory; furnished with golden pillars, gateways set with lapises, covered with networks of pearls, having three yielding the fruits of all seasons, endowed with the celerity of thought, ranging everywhere at will, wearing forms at pleasure, capable of coursing in the sky, with golden and jewelled stairs, and daises of polished gold, the vehicle of the gods undeteriorating, bringing delight to the mind and sight; wonderous exceedingly: painted with images designed to fill the mind with reverence, constructed by Brahmä, containing all objects of desire, charming and nonpariel not cold and not yet hot, granting gratification in every season, and graceful to

sa: न तत्र किंचिन्न कृतं प्रयत्नतो न तत्र किंचिन्न महार्घरत्नवत्। न ते विशेषा नियताः सुरेष्वपि न तत्र किंचिन्न महाविशेषवत्॥
en: There was nothing in that car which was not made skilfully; nothing that did not look like a precious jewel (sprung spontaneously on its person), and the style displayed in its various parts surpassed anything that could be found in the car of the celestials themselves, and everything in that car was executed in the highest style of excellence,

sa: अयुध्यमानं प्रच्छन्नं प्राञ्जलिं शरणागतम्। पलायमानं मत्तं वा न हन्तुं त्वमिहार्हसि॥ तस्यैव तु वधे यत्नं करिष्यामि महाभुज। आदेक्ष्यावो महावेगानस्त्रानाशीविषोपमान्॥
en: You should not slay him, who has retired from battle, has hidden himself, has sought your shelter, has stood before you with joined palms, has fled away or who is bewildered. O you of mighty-arms, let us try to slay him (Indrajit). And to accomplish it I shall use the weapons gifted with great impetuosity and resembling the serpents.

sa: त्वत्कृते सुकृताल्लोकान् गच्छेयं भरतर्षभ। या ते शक्तिर्बलं यच्च तत् क्षिप्रं मयि दर्शय॥ नेच्छामि तदहं द्रष्टुं मित्राणां व्यसनं महत्।
en: If I am indeed believed of you, O king, slay me without delay. O foremost of the Bharatas, them through your instrumentality I shall be launched upon the regions of the righteous. Bring into play, as soon as possible, all your might and prowess, against myself. This carnage of my friends, I do not wish to behold any longer.

sa: इति ब्रुवशल्यममित्रहन्ता कर्णो रणे मेघ इवोन्ननाद॥ अभ्येत्य पुत्रेण तवाभिनन्दितः समेत्य चोवाच कुरुप्रवीरम्। कृपं च भोज च महाभुजावुभौ तथैव गान्धारपति सहानुजम्॥ गुरोः सुतं चावरजं तथाऽऽत्मनः पदातिनोऽथ द्विपसादिनश्च तान्। निरुध्यताभिद्रवताच्युतार्जुनौ श्रमेण संयोजयताशु सर्वशः॥ यथा भवद्भिर्भृशविक्षितावुभौ सुखेन हन्यामहमद्य भूमिपाः।
en: Speaking the aforesaid words to Shalya, Karna, the smiter of his enemies, in that battle gave utterance to loud roars resembling those of the clouds and advanced towards your son (Duryodhana), the first of the Kurus, who respectfully saluted him and spoke the following words to him and to the strongarmed Kripa and to Bhoja Chief Kritavarman, to preceptor Drona's son and his younger brother and to the king of Gandhara and his son and to all elephant-riders, horsemen and infantry-“O kings, do you please push on towards Krishna and Arjuna and shut them up from all sides, when they feel tired and exhausted from fighting with you I shall be able to dispatch them off quite easily.

sa: अयं करिकराकारः पीनस्तनविमर्दनः। गोसहस्रप्रदाता च क्षत्रियान्तकरः करः॥ अनेन याज्ञसेन्या मे भीम केशा विकर्षिताः। पश्यतां कुरुमुख्यानां युष्माकं च सभासदाम्॥
en: It is my hand thick as that of elephant's trunk and capable to churn the protruded breasts of woman, offer in gift several thousand cows and destroy the Kshatriya in battle.O Bhimasena! I had caught Draupadi by hair by this very hand in the presence of the respected people in Kuru family and all of you were also there.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच मुह्यमानोऽब्रवीच्चापि मुहूर्त तिष्ठ संजय॥ व्याकुलं मे मनस्तात श्रुत्वा सुमहदप्रियम्। मनो मुह्यति चाङ्गानि न च शक्नोमि धारितुम॥
en: Dnritarashtra said Thereafter, he (the king) became almost senseless and addressed (after having recovered his senses a little) Sanjaya, saying.-'Do you stop for a moment.' O son, having heard of this exceedingly evil intelligence, my mind becomes becomes greatly perplexed. My mind (brain) as well as the different limbs are growing paralyzed, which I am not able to uphold.

sa: क्षुरधारा विषं सर्पो वह्रिरित्येकतः स्त्रियः। प्रजा इमा महाबाहो धार्मिक्य इति नः श्रुतम्॥ स्वयं गच्छन्ति देवत्वं ततो देवानियाद् भयम्।
en: She is the sharp edge of the razor. She is poison. She is a snake. She is fire. She is verily, all these in a body. We have heard that all human beings beings are characterised by righteousness, and that they, in course of natural progress and improvement, attain to the dignity of god. This circumstance alarmed the celestials.

sa: सत्ये रतानां सततं दान्तानामूर्ध्वरेतसाम्॥ ब्रह्मचर्यं दहेद् राजन् सर्वपापान्युपासितम्। ब्राह्मणेन विशेषेण ब्राह्मणो ह्याग्निरुच्यते॥ प्रत्यक्षं हि तथा ह्येतद् ब्राह्मणेषु तपस्विषु।
en: All of them, while here, were given to Truth, and self-control, and had their vital seed drawn up. The vow of Brahmacharya, O king, duly observed by a Brahmana, is sure to dissipate all his sins. The Brahmana is said to be a burning fire. In those Brahmanas that are given to penances, the deity of fire becomes visible.

sa: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं रहस्यमरिकर्शन। त्वमेव ार्थतत्त्वज्ञः पृष्टोऽस्मान् पृच्छसे यदा॥ तदस्माभिरिदं गुह्यं त्वत्प्रियार्थमुदाहृतम्। न च तेऽविदितं किंचित्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते॥
en: O Crusher of enemies, we have told you all about that mystery. You are yourself acquainted with the truth of every subject. Since, however, asked by us; You were kind enough to ask us in return, we have, therefore, recited everything to You for only pleasing You. There is nothing in the three worlds that You do not know.

sa: ततः स तं तथेत्युक्त्वा कल्पयित्वा महारथम्। भार्यां वामे धुरि तदा चात्मानं दक्षिणे तथा॥ त्रिदण्डं वज्रसूच्यग्रं प्रतोदं तत्र चादधत्।
en: The king said So be it, and soon made his great warchariot ready. And he yoked his wife thereto on the left and his own self on the right, And the king placed on the chariot, among its other articles, the goad which had three handles and which had a point hard as adamant and sharp as the needle.

sa: ववुश्च वात्सतुमुलाः सधूमा दिशश्च सर्वाः क्षुभिता बभूवुः॥ द्रोणो विकर्णोऽथ जयद्रथश्च भूरिश्रवाः कृतवर्मा कृपश्च। श्रुतायुरम्बष्ठपतिश्च राजा विन्दानुविन्दौ च मुदक्षिणश्च॥ प्राच्याश्च सौवीरगणाश्च सर्वे वसातयः क्षुद्रकमालवाश्च। निदेशगाः शान्तनवस्य राज्ञः॥ रनेकसाहस्रशतैर्ददर्श। किरीटिनं सम्परिवार्यमाणं शिनेर्नप्ता वारणयूथपैश्च॥ ततस्तु दृष्ट्वार्जुनवासुदेवौ पदातिनागाश्वरथैः समन्तात्। अभिद्रुतौ शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठौ शिनिप्रवीरोऽभिससार तूर्णम्॥ स तान्यनीकानि महाधनुष्माशिनिप्रवीरः सहसाभिपत्य। चकार साहाय्यम
en: The winds that blew appeared to be mixed with smoke; all the directions seemed to be agitated. Drona, Vikarna, Jayadratha, Bhurishrava, Kritvarma, Kripa, Shrutayusha, the ruler of Ambashta, Vinda and Anuvinda, Sudakshina, the people of the western country, the various tribes of Souviras, the Vasatis, the Kshudrakas, and the Malavas, all these at the command of the Gautamas royal son soon came to Kiritin (Arjuna) for battle. The grandson of Shini saw that Kiritin was surrounded by many thousands of horse and foot soldiers and car-warriors and great elephants. Having seen Vasudeva and Arjuna thus surrounded by infantry and elephants and horses and cars on all sides that foremost of all wielders of arms, that chief of the Shini's, soon went to that place. That ioremost of bowmen, the Shini Ch

sa: आर्जुनिः शरजालेन च्छादयामास भारत॥ चित्रसेनो विकर्णश्च कार्ष्णि पञ्चभिरायसैः। विव्याध तेन चाकम्पत् कार्णिमरुरिव स्थितः॥ दुःशासनस्तु समरे केकयान् पञ्च मारिष। योधयामास राजेन्द्र तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥ द्रौपदेया रणे क्रुद्धा दुर्योधनमवारयन्।
en: The son of Arjuna, O Bharata covered with a shower of arrows. Then Durjaya and Vikarna pierced the nephew of Krishna with five shafts made entirely of iron. But the nephew of Krishna moved not in the least and remained firm like the immovable Meru. In that conflict, O sire Dushasana fought with the five Kaikeya brothers; O mighty monarch, the battle that raged between them was indeed very wonderful. The sons of Draupadi excited with rage, in that battle, checked Duryodhana.

sa: कच्चिद् विनयसम्पन्नः कुलपुत्रो बहुश्रुतः। अनसू युरनुप्रष्टा सत्कृतस्ते पुरोहितः॥ कच्चिदग्निषु ते युक्तो विधिज्ञो मतिमानृजुः। हुतं च होष्यमाणं च काले वेदयते सदा॥ कच्चिदङ्गेषु निष्णातो ज्योतिषः प्रतिपादकः। उत्पातेषु च सर्वेषु दैवज्ञः कुशलस्तव॥
en: Does your honored priest possess humility and purity of blood? Is he without jealousy and illiberality? Is he renowned? Has some wellbehaved, intelligent and simple Brahmana learned in the ordinances been employed by you to perform your daily rites before the sacred fire? Does he always rites before the sacred fire? Does he always remind you in proper time as to when your Homa (sacrifice) has been performed and when it should be performed (again)? Is the astrologer you have employed competent in reading physiognomy and interpreting omens and in neutralizing the disturbance of Nature?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्तस्मिन् क्षणे कर्णः सलाजकुसुमैर्घटैः। काञ्चनैः काञ्चने पीद्दे मन्त्रविद्भिर्महारथः॥ अभिषिक्तोऽङ्गराज्ये स श्रिया युक्तो महाबलः। सच्छत्रवालव्यजनो जयशब्दोत्तरेण च॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When the cheers cease at that very moment the greatly powerful car-warrior Karna, seated on a golden seat, the (royal) umbrella over his head and yak tails waved by his side, was installed king of Anga by the Brahmanas, learned in the Mantras, in the proper form, with paddy, flowers, Ghata (water pots) and much fold.

sa: पद्मपत्रेक्षणः श्यामः श्रीमान् निरुदरो महान्। धर्मशः सत्यवादी च ह्रीनिषेधो जितेन्द्रियः॥ प्रियाभिभाषी मधुरो दीर्घबाहुररिंदमः। संत्यज्य विविधान् सौख्यानार्यं सर्वात्मना श्रितः॥
en: Of eyes resembling lotus petals, grey-hued, endued with grace, with a navel depressed, and mighty, Bharata understand righteousness, is truth-speaking, of restrained senses (in respect of other' wives) and also of subdued senses. And he speak fair, and is sweet-tempered, and longarmed and the vanquisher of foes. And renouncing various pleasures, he has devoted himself to the noble one.

sa: नावज्ञेयश्च भूतानां न च कालवशानुगः। एवं श्रेष्ठैर्गुणैर्युक्तः प्रजानां पार्थिवात्मजः॥ सम्मतस्त्रिषु लोकेषु वसुधायाः क्षमागुणैः। बुद्ध्या बृहस्पतेस्तुल्यो वीर्ये चापि शचीपतेः॥
en: He did not disregard any creature; he was no slave to the times. That son of the monarch was furnished with such qualities. And he was liked by the subjects as well as by the three worlds. In forgiveness he was like to the Earth; and in intelligence like to BỊhaspati; and in prowess like to the Sacī's lord.

sa: ततो व्यासस्थली नाम तत्र व्यासेनधीमता॥ पुत्रशोकाभितप्तेन देहत्यागे कृता मतिः। ततो देवैस्तु राजेन्द्र पुनरुत्थापितस्तदा॥ अभिगत्वा स्थलीं तस्य गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्।
en: One should then go to the Tirtha named Vyasasthali where the wise Vyasa. Afflicted as he was with the grief for the death of his son, determined to give up his being and where, O king of kings, he was cheered up by the celestials. Going to (Vyasa) sthali one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: ततो रामः सुसंक्रुद्धः क्षुरेणास्य महद् धनुः॥ चिच्छेद समरे वीरश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान् । हत्वा चाश्वाशरैस्तीक्ष्णैरर्धचन्द्रेण सारथेः॥ शिरो जहार तद्रक्षस्त्रिभिर्विव्याध वक्षसि।
en: Then heroic Răma highly angered, severed his (Dusana's) mighty bow with shafts sharp as razors, and slew his four horses by ineans of as many shafts. And having slain the steeds, he (Rāma) cut off the head of the charioteer by means of a crescent-shaped weapon, and pierced the (Rakşasa Dūşaņa) in the breast with a brace of shafts.

sa: देव्या मन्युकृतं मत्वा क्रुद्धः सर्वात्मकः प्रभुः। प्रसादात् तस्य दक्षेण स यज्ञः संधित: कथम्। एतद् वेदितुमिच्छेयं तन्मे ब्रूहि यथातथम्॥
en: Understanding that the goddess Uma had become filled with ire and grief, the powerful Mahadeva, who is the soul of all things, yielded to anger. How, again, through his grace, was Daksha enabled to gather again the divided limbs of that Sacrifice? I wish to know all this, Tell me all this, O Brahmana, truely as it took place.

sa: पुष्ट्यर्थं च स्वपुत्रस्य राजपुत्रस्य चैव हा फलमेकं सुतायादाद् राजपुत्राय चापरम्॥ अमृतास्वादसदृशं बलतेजोऽभिवर्धनम्। आदायादाय सैवाशु तयोः प्रादात् पुनः पुनः॥
en: She gave one of those fruits to her own child and the other to the prince. The fruits she brought were sweet like ambrosia, and capable of increasing strength and energy. Every day she brought them and every day she distributed them in the same way. The infant prince gained great strength from the fruit which Pujani give him.

sa: एतौ हि परमं धाम कानयोराह्निकक्रिया॥ पितरौ सर्वभूतानां दैवतं च यशस्विनौ। कां देवतां तु यजतः पितॄन् वा कान् महामती॥
en: These two are the highest refuge of the universe. What can be the nature of the daily rites these two perform? They are the fathers of all creatures and the illustrious gods of all beings. Gifted with great intelligence, what is that god whom these two adore? Who are those Pitris whom these two Pitris of all beings worship.

sa: संजय उवाच हते तस्मिन् महावीर्ये सौभद्रे रथयूथपे। विमुक्तस्थसंनाहाः सर्वे निक्षिप्तकार्मुकाः॥ उपोपविष्टा राजानं परिवार्य युधिष्ठिरम्। तदेव युद्धं ध्यायन्तः सौभद्रगतमानसाः॥
en: Sanjaya said When that hero that leader of a car-division viz., Subhadra's son had been slain in battle, leaving their cars and doffing their coats of mail and throwing aside their bows, all the Pandavas sat surrounding king Yudhishthira. They were then brooding upon their grief with their hearts occupied with the thought of the deceased son of Subhadra.

sa: तथा बर्हिप्रयुक्तैश्च षष्ठरात्रोपवासिनः। त्रिरात्रं क्षपते यस्तु एकभक्तेन पाण्डव॥ अन्तरा चैव नाश्नाति तस्य लोका ह्यनामयाः। पानीयस्य गुणा दिव्याः प्रेतलोकसुखावहाः॥
en: O son of Pandu, those that have fasted for six nights, go on cars drawn by peacocks. O son of Pandu, he who fasts for three nights taking only one meal without a second goes to a region free from disease and anxiety. The water has this excellent property that it produces happiness in the region of the dead.

sa: देतद् राजंस्त्वरमाणः कुरुष्व। तथैतदेवं न करोषि राजन् ध्रुवं कुरूणां भविता विनाशः॥
en: O king, if you wish to restore to you sons the good fortune they have lost this speedily act as I say, O king, if you do not act thus, the Kurus will be soon destroyed.

sa: एतामवस्थां सम्प्राप्तो धर्मज्ञः सन् पुरंदर। नूनं दैवं न शक्यं हि पौरुषेणातिवर्तितुम्॥
en: Forsooth, Destiny is incapable of being warded off or conquered by individual exertion since, O lord, I am unable to acquire, despite these.persistent attempts of mine the object for the acquisi.ion of which I am trying.

sa: स निष्क्रम्य ददौ युद्धं तेभ्यो राजा महाबलः। देवासुरसमं घोरं दिवोदासो महाद्युतिः॥
en: The powerful king Divodasa gifted with great splendour, issuing out of his capital, gave them battle. The engagement between the two parties terrible like the encounter in days of old between the celestials and the Asuras.

sa: अगस्त्यः सत्रमासीनश्चकार मृगयामृषिः। आरण्यान् सर्वदेवेभ्यो मृगान् प्रेषन् महावने॥ प्रमाणदृष्टधर्मेण कथमस्मान् विगर्हसे। अगस्त्यस्याभिचारेण युष्माकं विहितो वधः॥
en: The Rishi Agastya, while engaged in a (great) sacrifice, hunted, he deer in the great forest and offered every one of them to the celestial. Agastya performed the Homa with the fat of the deer. You have been killed according to such precedents. Why then do you reprove me?

sa: प्रणिपाते न दोषोऽस्ति सन्धिनः शाश्वतीः समाः। पितरं त्वेव शोचामि प्रज्ञानेनं जनाधिपम्॥
en: There is no objection to our surrender; for men or our position seek peace from a long time; but I grieve for my father, that lord of men, who has his wisdom only for his eyes.

sa: कदूरुवाच कृष्णवालमहं मन्ये हयमेनं शुचिस्मिते। एहि सार्धं मया दीव्य दासीभावाय भामिनि॥
en: Kadru said : O sweet lady of smiles, I think the horse is black in its tail. Let us lay this wager that she, whose words will be untrue, will become the slave of the other.

sa: बहुपांसुचयाश्चापि परिखाः परिवारिताः। तत्रेन्द्रनीलप्रतिमाः प्रतोलीवरशोभिताः॥ प्रासादमालासंयुक्ताः सौधप्राकारसंवृताः। पताकाशोभिताः सर्वे सुनिर्मितमहापथाः॥ विसर्पद्भिरिवाकाशे विटङ्काग्रविमानकैः। समुच्छ्रितैर्निवेशास्ते बभुः शक्रपुरोपमाः॥
en: And the tents surrounded by an entrenchment paved with dust, containing images made of sapphires, graced with goodly thoroughfares, lined with edifices, encircled by towers and walls, decorated with streamers, having wellmade high-ways, and appearing like celestial daises and containing stately mansions dovecotes, resembled the metropolis of Śakra himself.

sa: विचनीयस्य यो भुङ्क्ते तमाहुः शोणितं ह्रदम्। पिशुनं भोजनं भुङ्क्ते ब्रह्महत्यासमं विदुः॥
en: The food of a person who is censured by all, is said to be like a drink from a pool of blood. The acceptance of food from a wicked person is as the killing of Brahmana.

sa: याज्ञवल्क्य उवाच न शक्यो निर्गुणस्तात गुणीकर्तुं विशाम्पते। गुणवांश्चाप्यगुणवान् यथातत्त्वं निबोध मे॥
en: That which is without qualities, O son, can never be explained by assigning qualities to it. Listen, however, to me as I explain to you what is endued with qualities and what is devoid of them.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाऽच्युत। स्थितोऽस्मि गतसंदेहः करिष्ये वचनं तव॥
en: Arjuna said O undecaying One, through your favour my delusion is gone, I now know what I am. I am now firm. My doubts have been dispelled. I will obey you. I will do your bidding.

sa: वाचा भृशं विनीतः स्याद्धदयेन तथा क्षुरः। स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषी स्यात् सृष्टो रौद्राय कर्मणे॥
en: They should be humble in speech, but their hearts must be as sharp as the razors. When you are engaged in doing a very cruel and terrible act, you should talk with smiles on your lips.

sa: यदि दत्तं यदि हुतं गुरवस्तोषिता यदि। एकभर्तृत्वमेवास्तु सत्यं यद्यस्ति वा मयि॥
en: If ever a gift has been made by me or an offering (made by me) or my superiors satisfied by me and if there is any truth in me, let me be with one husband only.

sa: राजोवाच भगवन् वैतहव्यैर्मे युद्धे वंशः प्रणाशितः। अहमेकः परियूनो भवन्तं शरणं गतः॥
en: The king said O holy one, the sons of Vitahavya have killed all the children and men of my house. I only have escaped with life, totally discomfited by the enemy, I seek refuge with you.

sa: अनेन निश्चयेनेह वयं प्रस्थापिता नृप। प्राप्तानीमानि यानानि चतुरङ्गं च ते बलम्॥
en: O king, we have been dispatched to you on the strength of this determination (on the part of your subjects to install you king). These cars and these four kinds of troops have arrived for you.

sa: श्री भगवानुवाच अवाच्यमेतद् वक्तव्यमात्मगुह्यं सनातनम्। तव भक्तिमतो ब्रह्मन् वक्ष्यामि तु यथातथम्॥
en: This topic is one regarding which nothing should be said. It is an ancient ministry. Your devotion to me is very great. Hence, O twiceborn one, I shall describe it to you according to the truth.

sa: अज्ञातं कर्म कृत्वा च क्लेशो नान्यत् प्रहीयते। नाग्निर्दहति कर्माणि भावशून्यस्य देहिनः॥
en: The man whose heart is without holiness suffers torture by undergoing penances only being ignorant of their meaning. He is never freed from sins of such acts. The fire he worships does not consume his sins.

sa: निर्मुक्तानां पन्नागानां सरूपा दृष्ट्वा शक्तीहेमचित्रा निकृत्ताः। प्रादुश्चक्रे दिव्यमस्त्रं महात्मा क्रोधाविष्टो हैहयेशप्रमाथी॥
en: son Seeing those arrows, decked with gold, flying at him like serpents let loose from their holes, the great-souled smiter of the lord of the Haihayas became excited with wrath and again brought forth celestial weapons.

sa: तथा सपत्नान् विकिरन् किरीटी चचार संख्येऽतिरथो रथेन। शोणाश्ववाहस्य हयान् निहत्य वैकर्तनभ्रातुरदीनसत्त्वः। एकेन संग्रामजितः शरेण किरीटमाली।॥
en: So the mighty car-warrior Kiritin ranged in the battle field in his chariot dispersing his enemies. Then killing the horses of the brother of Vikartana's son, that one of undeteriorating energy. Ever victorious in battle and decked with a brilliant diadem, with one shaft, speedily cut off his head.

sa: यच्चापि द्रव्यमुपयुज्यते ह वानस्पत्यमायसं पार्थिवं वा। दिव्येन रूपेण च प्रज्ञया च तेनैव सिद्धिरिति विद्धि विद्वन्॥
en: scholar! put it properly in your understanding that the offerings made by Brahmins are consisting of the wooden products like Shruva, fuel, the glittering items like gold etc. and physical items like Brihi etc. These all items as a gross effect provide me with divine complexion and conscience both.

sa: याज्ञवल्क्य उवाच कृत्स्नधारिणमेव त्वां मन्ये गन्धर्वसत्तम। जिज्ञाससे च मां राजंस्तन्निबोध यथाश्रुतम्॥
en: Yajnavalkya said You are, O foremost of Gandharvas, capable of comprehending every knowledge. As, however, you ask me, do you hear me then explain to you according as I myself have obtained it from my preceptor.

sa: प्रसन्नस्य च मे तात पश्य व्युष्टिं यथाविधि। यावदेव मनुष्याणामन्ने भावो भविष्यति॥ यथैवान्ने तथा तेषां त्वयि भावो भविष्यति। यावच्च पुण्या लोकेषु त्वयि कीर्तिर्भविष्यति॥
en: Behold duly, O son, what the power is of myself when I become pleased with any one. As long as celestials and human beings will continue to entertain a liking for food, so long will every one among them cherish the same liking for you that they cherish for their food. As long, again as there will be Virtue in the several worlds, so long will the fame of your deeds last.

sa: ततः सुमन्त्रोऽपि रथाद् विमुच्य श्रान्तान् हयान् सम्परिवर्त्य शीघ्रम्। नचारयद् वै तमसाविदूरे॥
en: Then Sumantra unyoked the fatigued horses from the car, which at once fell to rolling in the dust. And then bathing and making them drink, he soon as the dusk set in, set fare before them.

sa: नहि तत् पुरुषव्याघ्रो दुःख दर्शनं पितुः। मातुश्च सहितुं शक्तस्तोत्रैर्नुन्न इव द्विपः।॥
en: And that foremost of men was incapable of bearing the looks of his father and mother, like to an elephant afflicted with the hook, (not being able to look at what is placed on its back.)

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं परं कौतूहलं हि मे। महर्षे त्वं समर्थोऽसि ज्ञातुमेवंविधं नरम्॥
en: I have great curiosity to hear of such a person. You can, O Maharşi,* know about a man of this description. *A great saint. The word, however, signifies one belonging to a particular order of saints.

sa: यदीदं ते क्षमं राजन् गमिष्यामि यथागतम्। मिथ्याप्रतिज्ञः काकुत्स्थ सुखी भव सुहृद्वृतः॥
en: If, O king, in acting thus, you have acted properly, I will then repair to the place whence I had come. O Kākutstha's descendant false in promise, do you attain happiness, being surrounded by your friends.

sa: द्विजातिचरितो धर्मः शास्त्रे दृष्टः सनातनैः। यदि ते धर्मनिरते त्वया पुत्रे विवासिते॥
en: If you had believed in the morality prescribed in the scriptures, and which is followed by the twice-born ones, you would not have banished your son. But disregarding such morality, you have banished your virtuous son.

sa: इयमद्य निशा पूर्वा सौमित्रे प्रहिता वनम्। वनवासस्य भद्रं ते न चोत्कण्ठितुमर्हसि॥
en: O son of Sumitrā, this is the first night of our exile into the forest. From this day it behoveth you not, good betide you, to suffer your mind to grieve (by dwelling on past joys.)

sa: इच्छाम्यहमपि द्रष्टुं भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। नेच्छे चिरं धारयितुं प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्ये कलेवरम्। महर्षिस्त्वब्रवीदेवं दृष्टतत्त्वार्थदर्शनः॥
en: I also am desirous of beholding the brothers, Rāma and Laksmana. I do not wish to hold this life long. I would renounce my life.' That Maharși, conversant with the nature of things, told me this.'

sa: न धारये कोपमुदीर्णवेगं निहन्मि सुग्रीवमसत्यमद्य। हरिप्रवीरैः सह वालिपुत्रो नरेन्द्रपुत्र्या विचयं करोतु॥
en: I am unable to bear the outburst of my ire forsooth shall I kill today, that liar Sugrīva. May the son of Vāli with other principal monkeys engage in quest of that daughter of a king.

sa: ततः कृतार्थाः सहिताः सबान्धवा मयार्चिताः सर्वगुणैर्मनोरमैः। चरिष्यथोवीं प्रति शान्तशात्रवाः सहप्रियाभूतधराः प्लवङ्गमाः॥
en: Then, having achieved success, do you, along with your friends, honoured by me, and crowned with every virtue, you monkeys, with your enemies slain, range the earth in company with your wives,-the support of all beings.

sa: तमुवाचाथ गान्धारी मैवं पुत्र शृणुष्व च। त्वय्यधीनं कुरुकुलं पिण्डश्च श्वशुरस्य मे॥
en: Gandhari then said to him. 'O son, let it not be so. Listen, the family of Kuru is now dependent on you. The obsequial cake also of my father-in-law depends on you Depart then, O son.

sa: गौतम उवाच इध्मोदकप्रदातारं शून्यपालं ममाश्रमे। विनीतमाचार्यकुले सुयुक्तं गुरुकर्मणि॥ शिष्टं दान्तं कृतज्ञं च प्रियं च सततं मम। न मे विक्रोशतो राजन् हर्तुमर्हसि कुञ्जरम्॥
en: Gautamia said You should not, O king, take away by force this elephant which brings me my fuel and water, which protects my hermitage when I am away, which is exceedingly docile and obedient to his instructor, which carefully does what his preceptor commands, which is mild and wellbroken, and which is grateful and very dear to me. Indeed, you should not take it away without caring for my protestalions and cries.

sa: महेश्वर उवाच न्यायस्तस्ते महाभागे सर्वशः समुदीरितः। भूमिदेवा महाभागाः सदा लोके द्विजातयः॥
en: Maheshvara said O highly blessed lady, the question you have put, is a very proper one. Those persons who belong to the twice bom order, are considered as highly blessed, and are, indeed, gods on earth.

sa: ब्राह्मणे दारुणं नास्ति मैत्रो ब्राह्मण उच्यते। आचार्यः सर्वभूतानां शास्ता किं प्रहरिष्यति॥
en: There is no harshness in a Brahmana. The Brahmana is said to be the friend of all creatures. He is the teacher also of all creatures and their ruler. Can he punish any creature so cruelly.

sa: यच्चावसं जाह्नवीतीरनित्यः शतं समास्तप्यमानस्तपोऽहम्। अदां च तत्राश्वतरीसहस्रं नारीपुरं न च तेनाहमागाम्॥
en: For a hundred years I lived continuously by the side of the sacred Jahnavi, all the while performed the severest austerities. There I made gifts to the Brahmanas of thousands of males and numberless female slaves.

sa: यथाश्रु पतितं तेषां दीनानामथ सीदताम्। ब्राह्मणानां हृते क्षेत्रे हन्यात् त्रिपुरुषं कुलम्॥
en: The tears that would drop from the eyes of such cheerless and destitute Brahmaras on account of their lands being resumed, are capable of destroying the ancestors and descendants to the third generation of the resumer.

sa: विधूय कलुषं सर्वं विरजाः सम्मतः सताम्। लोके महीयते सद्भिर्यां ददाति वसुन्धराम्॥
en: That king who makes a gift of earth is purged off of every sin and, therefore, is pure and liked by the righteous. In this world he is highly honoured and praised by all righteous men.

sa: नावमन्येदभिगतं न प्रणुद्यात् कदाचन। अपि वपाके शुनि वा न दानं विप्रणश्यति॥
en: The householder should never disregard the man who comes to his place, nor should he insult him by sending him away. A gift of food made to even a Chandala or a dog is never lost.

sa: एवमन्नाद्धि सूर्यश्च पवनः शुक्रमेव च। एक एव स्मृतो राशिस्ततो भूतानि जज्ञिरे॥
en: Thus from food, the Sun and the god of wind and the vital seed spring and act. All these are said to form one element or quantity, and it is from these that all creatures originate.

sa: सूर्य उवाच महर्षे शिरसस्त्राणं छत्रं मद्रश्मिवारणम्। प्रतिगृह्णष्व पद्भ्यां च त्राणार्थं चर्मपादुके॥
en: Surya said Do you, O great Rishi, take this umbrella with which the head may be protected and my rays warded off. This pair of sandals is made of leather for the protection of the feet.

sa: उपानहो च यो दद्यात् पात्रभूते द्विजोत्तमे। छत्रदाने सुखां छायां लभते परलोकगः॥
en: That man who gives away a pair of sandals to a superior Brahmana who is worthy of the gift, acquires similar merits. By giving away an umbrella, a person gets comfortable shade in the next world.

sa: ब्राह्मण्यां लक्ष्यते सूत इत्येतेऽपसदाः स्मृताः। पुत्रा ह्येते न शक्यन्ते मिथ्याकर्तुं नराधिप॥
en: Indeed, the son begotten by a Kshatriya upon a Brahmana woman, is called a Suta. These three also are called Apasadas. It cannot be said, O king, that these six kinds of sons are no sons.

sa: न चान्यामपि पश्यामि गतिं गतिमतां वर। स्वर्गद्वारस्य गमने स्थाने चेह द्विजोत्तम॥
en: Indeed, O foremost of all persons, having a high goal, I do not see any other refuge for myself in the matter of approaching the celestial gates or in continuing here, O best of twice-born ones.

sa: तस्य पुत्रोऽतिचक्राम पितरं गुणवत्तया। मरुत्तो नाम धर्मज्ञश्चक्रवर्ती महायशाः॥ नागायुतसमप्राणः साक्षाद् विष्णुरिवापरः।
en: His son excelled his father in the possession of good qualities; named Marutta, that lord of kings was righteous and of great fame; having the power of ten thousand elephants, and like unto Vishnu's second self.

sa: प्रयत्नं तत्र कुर्वाणास्तस्मात् कूपाज्जलार्थिनः। श्रमेण महत. युक्तास्तस्मिंस्तोये सुसंवृते॥ ददृशुस्ते महाकायं कृकलासमवस्थितम्। तस्य चोद्धरणे यत्नमकुर्वंस्ते सहस्रशः॥
en: Desirous of drawing water from it, they worked hard for removing the creepers they covered its mouth. After the mouth had been cleaned, they saw within the well a very large lizard living within it. The youths nade strong and repeated efforts for rescuing the lizard from that plight.

sa: ऋषिरुवाच ते देशास्ते जनपदास्तेऽऽश्रमास्ते च पर्वताः। येषां भागीरथी गङ्गा मध्येनैति सरिद्वरा॥
en: The Rishi said Those countries, those provinces, those retreats, and those mountains, should be considered as the foremost in sanctity through which or by the side of which that foremost of all rivers viz., Bhagirathi, flows.

sa: यः सर्वमांसानि न भक्षयीत पुमान् सदा भावितो धर्मयुक्तः। मातापित्रोरर्चिता सत्ययुक्तः शुश्रूषिता ब्राह्मणानामनिन्द्यः।॥ अक्रोधनो गोषु तथा द्विजेषु धर्मे रतो गुरुशुश्रूषकश्चा यावज्जीवं सत्यवृत्ते रतश्च दाने रतो यः क्षमी चापराधे॥ मृदुर्दान्तो देवपरायणश्च सर्वातिथिश्चापि तथा दयावान्। ईदृग्गुणो मानवस्तं प्रयाति लोकं गवां शाश्वतं चाव्ययं च॥
en: He who abstains from every kind of flesh, who is possessed of a pure heart, who is gifted with righteousness, who worships his parents with respect, who is endued with truthfulness of speech and conduct, who attends with obedience upon the Brahmanas, who is faultless in conduct, who never behaves with anger towards kine and towards the Brahmanas, who performs every duty, who serves his preceptors with reverence, who is devoted for his whole life to truth and to gifts, and who is always forgiving towards all transgressions against himself, who is mild and selfcontrolled, who is full of respect for the celestials, who is hospitable to all guests, who is gifted with mercy, indeed, he who is adorned with these attributes, succeeds in attaining to the eternal region of kine.

sa: विक्रयार्थं हि यो हिंस्याद् भक्षयेद् वा निरङ्कुशः। घातयानं हि पुरुषं येऽनुमन्येयुरर्थिनः॥ घातकः खादको वापि तथा यश्चानुमन्यते। यावन्ति तस्या रोमाणि तावद् वर्षाणि मज्जति॥
en: He who, without being governed by the restrains of the Scriptures, sells a cow, or kills one, or eats the flesh of a cow, or they who, for the sake of money, allow a person to kill kine, all these, viz., he that kills, he that eats, and he that allows the destriction, rot in hell for as many years as there are hairs on the body of the cow so killed.

sa: शूरा बहुविधाः प्रोक्तास्तेषामर्थांस्तु मे शृणु। शूरान्वयानां निर्दिष्टं फलं शूरस्य चैव हि॥
en: Various kinds of heroes have been spoken of. Listen to me as I explain to you what the rewards are that they attain to. The rewards are fixed of a hero belonging to a heroic race.

sa: दृढपूर्वं श्रुतं मूर्ख कुपितं हृदयप्रियम्। अनुनेतुं न शक्नोषि तेनासि हरिणः कृशः॥
en: Some dear kinsman of yours, shorn of intelligence though repeatedly instructed in the scriptures has become angry. You have not been able to pacify him. It is for this that you are so pale and lean.

sa: निवापे हव्यकव्ये वा गर्हितं च सुदर्शनम्। पितरश्च हि देवाश्च नाभिनन्दन्ति तद्धविः॥
en: Among offerings made to the departed Manes or with the Havya and Kavya offered to the celestials, the potherb called Sudarshana should not be included. Havi mixed with this is not acceptable to the departed Manes.

sa: वेदांश्च ब्रह्मचर्येण न्यायतः प्रार्थयामहे। न्यायेनोत्तरकालं च गृहेभ्यो निःसृता वयम्॥ धर्मदृष्टैर्विधिद्वारैस्तपस्तप्स्यामहे वयम्। भवतः सम्यगिष्टा तु बुद्धिहिंसाविवर्जिता॥
en: We should worship the celestials, practicing Brahmacharya by lawful mean. Completing the period of Brahmacharya we have come out of our house, observing lawful methods. That that your suffer any understanding, which is freed from the desire of inflicting any kind of injury on others is approved by us.

sa: लोकेऽस्मिन् दक्षिणानां च सर्वासां वयमुत्तमाः। भवेम न च लिप्येम दोषेणेति परंतप॥
en: Indeed, O scorcher of enemies, they said to themselves. We shall, in this world, become the best of all kinds of presents in sacrifices, and we shall not be liable to be sullied with any fault.

sa: अतिथीनां च सर्वेषां प्रेष्याणां स्वजनस्य च। तथा शरणकामानां गोप्ता स्यात् स्वागतप्रदः॥
en: The righteous or good man is he who protects his guests, servants and other dependants, his own relatives, and all those who seek his protection. Such a man always welcomes these with the usual polite enquiries.

sa: ऋषिभिः संशयं पृष्टो वसुश्चेदिपतिः पुरा। अभक्ष्यमपि मांसं यः प्राह भक्ष्यमिति प्रभा॥
en: Doubtful about the propriety of eating flesh, the Rishis asked Vasu the king of the Chedis, for removing their doubt. King Vasu, knowing that flesh should not be taken, answered that it was edible, O king.

sa: नातः पुण्यतरं दानं नातः पुण्यतरं फलम्। नातो विशिष्ठं लोकेषु भूतं भवितुमर्हति॥
en: There is no gift more sacred than that of kine. There is no gift that yields more blessed merit. There has been nothing equal to the cow, nor will there be anything that will cqual her.

sa: स्तस्मै प्रयच्छन्ति सुखानि देवाः। तद्भाविता: स्पर्शनदर्शनेन इष्टां गतिं तस्य सुरा दिशन्ति॥
en: That mortal who live by the side of Ganga and sees her every day, becomes purified by her sight and touch. To him the gods give every sort of happiness here and a high end hereafter.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रीतात्मा कुरुनन्दनः। नाश्रमेऽरोचयद् वासं वीरमार्गाभिकाझ्या॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing these words of his grandfather, Yudhishthira, the delighter of the Kurus, became anxious to get the end reserved for heroes and no longer expressed any disgust for leading a domestic mode of life.

sa: तेन चैव हि तुष्टेन स यज्ञः संधितोऽभवत्। यद् यच्चापहृतं तत्र तत्तथैवान्वजीवयत्॥
en: When Rudra became pleased, the embodiment of sacrifice, which had been cut in twain, became once more united. Whatever limbs of his had been destroyed by the arrows of Mahadeva, became once more whole and sound.

sa: तव मम च गुणैर्महानुभावा जुषतु मतिं सततं स्वधर्मयुक्तः। अभिमतजनवत्सला हि गङ्गा जगति युनक्ति सुखैश्च भक्तिमन्तम्॥
en: Ganga always extends her favour to those who are devoted to her in huinbleness of heart. She unites those who are so devoted to her with every kind of happiness. I pray that the highly blessed Ganga may always inspire your heart and mine with the attributes of virtue.

sa: कीर्तनं श्रवणं दानं दर्शनं चापि पार्थिव। गवां प्रशस्यते वीर सर्वपापहरं शिवम्॥
en: To speak of kine, to hear others speak of then, to make gifts of kine, and to see kine, O king, are acts, that are all praised, O hero, and that are highly auspicious and purifying.

sa: शरत्काले तु सलिलं तडागे यस्य तिष्ठति। गोसहस्रस्य स प्रेत्य लभते फलमुत्तमम्॥
en: The high reward in the world that is reaped by the person who makes a gift of a thousand kine is acquired by that man in whose tank water is held in the season of autumn.

sa: त्रिशिरास्तं प्रचिच्छेद शरैराशीविषोपमैः। स वृक्षं कृत्तमालोक्य उत्पपात तदाङ्गदः।७।। स ववर्ष ततो वृक्षाशिलाश्च कपिकुञ्जरः। तान्प्रचिच्छेद संक्रुद्धस्त्रिशिरा निशितैः शरैः॥ परिघाग्रेण तान्वृक्षान्बभञ्ज स महोदरः। त्रिशिराश्चाङ्गदं वीरमभिदुद्राव सायकैः।९।। गजेन समभिद्रुत्य वालिपुत्रं महोदरः। जघानोरसि संक्रुद्धस्तोमरैर्वज्रसंनिभैः॥
en: Trisiras cut off that tree in pieces by means of shafts resembling serpents. And seeing the tree severed, Angada darted up; and then that foremost of monkeys showered crags and trees. And all those Triſiras wrought with wrath cut off by means of whetted arrows; and Mahodara snapped those trees with the end of his bludgeon. And then Trisiras rushed against that hero-Valr's son-with shafts; and Mahodara chased him, mounted own an elephant; and struck Angada in the chest with Tomaras resembling the thunder-bolt. 1. The text has Angada avoided for euphony. 2. The text has Vali's son.

sa: ततस्तु ते राक्षसऋक्षवानराः प्रणम्य रामं रघुवंशवर्धनम्। वियोगजाश्रुप्रतिपूर्णलोचनाः प्रति प्रयातास्तु यथा निवासिनः॥
en: Thereupon the Rākşasas, bears, monkeys, having bowed to Rāma, the glory of the Raghu family and with their eyes full of tears consequent upon his separation, went away to the countries from which they had hailed.

sa: लङ्घिते तत्र तैः सैन्यैर्जितमित्येव निश्चिनु। सर्वं तीर्णं च मे सैन्यं जितमित्यवधार्यताम्॥
en: On these forces getting beyond the ocean, do you take it for certain that we have won; and when my whole host has reached the further shore, do you indubitably conclude that we have obtained victory.

sa: अयं महात्मा च महांश्च वीर्यतः समाहितश्चातिसहश्च संयुगे। असंशयं कर्मगुणोदयादयं सनागयज्ञैर्मुनिभिश्च पूजितः॥
en: This one is high-souled, mighty in energy, of concentrated self, and capable of bearing extreme hardships in war; without doubt, by virtue of his actions, he is worthy of being honoured by Nagas, Yaksas and ascetics.

sa: हिमहतनलिनीव नष्टशोभा व्यसनपरम्परया निपीड्यमाना। सहचररहितेव चक्रवाकी जनकसुता कृपणां दशां प्रपन्ना ॥
en: Being harassed with continued miseries, the daughter of Janaka has lost all her beauty like to a water-lily crushed with frost, and has come by a miserable plight like to a doe separated from her mate.

sa: निक्षिप्तविजयो रामो गतश्रीर्वनगोचरः। व्रती स्थण्डिलशायी च शङ्के जीवति वा न वा॥
en: Rāma has ceased from his endeavours for gaining victory. He has lost all his beauty, lives in the forest, is engaged in observances and always lies down on earth. I fear whether he is living still.

sa: तालान्दाडिमगुल्मांश्च नारिकेलविभीतकान्। हस्तिमात्रान्महाकायाः पाषाणांश्च महाबलाः।।५५ पर्वतांश्च समुत्पाट्य यन्त्रैः परिवहन्ति च। करीरान्बकुलान्नम्बान्समाजहुरितस्ततः॥
